$comment: Root config: shared strictness only. It compiles nothing — `files: []` and `include: []`
make it a base that apps extend, because apps/api (Node) and apps/web (Next.js) need
different module resolution, libs and JSX settings. One config cannot serve both honestly.
No `baseUrl` and no `paths`. Cross-package imports resolve through npm workspaces, which
works at runtime as well as at compile time — `paths` is compile-time only, so tsc would
pass while node failed at import. `baseUrl` is also deprecated as of TypeScript 5.5.
